Name: Dayswork
Author: Bindicle
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Tired of doing all the farm work yourself? Hire a Farmhand to handle the daily chores while you explore, fish, or just relax. Purchase a Farmhand Cabin from Robin and set up customized daily contracts to have your helper work on crops, animals, clearing, and more. Track their energy throughout the day and configure exactly which tasks they tackle and in what order.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Click on the cabin to open the UI.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Note: This uses a Marnie placeholder as the Farmhand. I am working on creating a sprite replacement.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Note: This mod does not work with multiplayer at this time.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Install SMAPI[/b] — Download and follow setup instructions from [url=https://smapi.io/]smapi.io[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Download this mod[/b] — Extract the  [/color][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Dayswork[/color][/size][color=#D4D4D8] folder into your [/color][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/color][/size][color=#D4D4D8] directory[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Launch the game[/b] through SMAPI[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i]Optional:[/i] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game configuration[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Hire Farmhand[/b] — Purchase a Farmhand Cabin from Robin and manage contracts from the bulletin board[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Manage Seasonal Crops  [/b]— Tell the farmhand which crops to plant in which season. They'll even buy the seeds for you.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Flexible Work Scope[/b] — Define work zones, select animal buildings, and choose greenhouse inclusion[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Task Customization[/b] — Select which tasks your farmhand performs: water crops, harvest, collect animal products, feed/pet animals, cut trees, clear rocks, pull weeds, and more[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Priority System[/b] — Drag to reorder task priorities; your farmhand tackles higher categories first[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Energy System[/b] — Choose energy tiers (Half Day, Full Day, Overtime) that affect work capacity and cost[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Smart Item Deposit[/b] — Automatic delivery to chests or shipping bins; configurable per task type[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Contract Types[/b] — Set up one-time jobs or recurring daily contracts with full management controls[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Overflow Handling[/b] — Missed items are safely deposited in the cabin chest or shipping bin[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Festival-Aware[/b] — Respects in-game holidays (configurable)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Inheritance [/b]—The Farmhand inherits your tool quality to allow natural game progression[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SVE Compatible  [/b]— Includes all SVE animal types, animal products, and Grandpa's Shed as a workable location[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b] — Required for running SMAPI mods[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — [i]Optional[/i] — Adds an in-game config menu for easier settings adjustment[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Roadmap[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Use custom sprites for Farmhand and Building (I'm trying to learn how to do pixel art)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Advanced filtering and item depositing[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Multiple farmhands[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Multiplayer support[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Additional tasks ([s]fertilizing[/s], fishing, mining, [s]tilling[/s], etc)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Purchasable upgrades[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]NPC dialog[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Complex automation (managing storage, transferring between production items, quality-based actions, etc)[/size][/*]
[/list]
